Definition: of Hebrew origin (H8050); Samuel (i.e. Shemuel), an Israelite:--Samuel.
BiblicalUsage: Samuel is the prophet Samuel. You find the name in Acts 3:24, "…as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold…", and again in Hebrews 11:32 and Acts 13:20.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Samuel counts, because God wrote the name down and I believe he meant it. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
